tokens.name: qvl-petrol
tokens.usage: Hauptfarbe. Headlines, primary buttons, table heads, card edges; text on white and surface-card (6.8:1). In dark mode it fills surfaces only: text and lines use qvl-petrol-mid.

tokens.name: qvl-orange
tokens.usage: Akzent 1, the single loudest thing on a view: CTA, highlight, badge, the colon between set scores. Fills only; white on orange is 2.9:1, so labels on it are qvl-ink (5.9:1), never white.

tokens.name: qvl-yellow
tokens.usage: Akzent 2. Focus ring and selection; text, score digits and eyebrows on qvl-petrol or qvl-night (6.3:1 / 15:1); a fill under qvl-ink (16:1). Never text, icon or thin line on white (1.07:1).

tokens.name: qvl-white
tokens.usage: Card and field fill; labels on qvl-petrol and qvl-pink fills (pink: large type and buttons only). Never on qvl-orange fills: use qvl-ink.

tokens.name: qvl-grey
tokens.usage: Grundfarbe. Hairlines, subtle borders, disabled fills; never text.

tokens.name: qvl-grey-light
tokens.usage: Seitenhintergrund (page ground) and the second zebra row; text on it is qvl-ink or qvl-ink-muted.

tokens.name: qvl-petrol-mid
tokens.usage: Approved tint. Petrol as text, line or frame in dark mode (5.3:1 on qvl-night, 4.6:1 on qvl-night-card); start stop of the Tiefe gradient.

tokens.name: qvl-petrol-pale
tokens.usage: Approved tint. Soft brand surface and hover fill for outline buttons; text on it is qvl-petrol or qvl-ink.

tokens.name: qvl-orange-mid
tokens.usage: Approved tint. Link hover on dark grounds, orange highlights on night.

tokens.name: qvl-orange-pale
tokens.usage: Approved tint. Soft accent surface (warn status, accent card); text on it is qvl-ink or qvl-petrol.

tokens.name: qvl-pink
tokens.usage: Akzent 3. Behaves like orange: highlight, CTA, badge, Pride/tournament moments; fills only. White on pink is 4.0:1, so labels on it are large type and buttons only; body copy goes on qvl-pink-pale in qvl-ink.

tokens.name: qvl-pink-mid
tokens.usage: Pink mixed 60 % toward white; pink tint for large decorative fields. Derived, flagged for QVL approval.

tokens.name: qvl-pink-pale
tokens.usage: Pink mixed 20 % toward white; soft pink surface under qvl-ink body copy. Derived, flagged for QVL approval.

tokens.name: qvl-pink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of pink buttons (pink mixed 88 % with black).

tokens.name: qvl-pink-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of pink buttons (pink mixed 78 % with black).

tokens.name: qvl-ink
tokens.usage: Body copy on surface-card, surface-page and the pale tints (15:1+); label on yellow and orange fills (orange: 5.9:1). An addition to the CI sheet, flagged for approval.

tokens.name: qvl-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-card and surface-page (8.5:1 on white, 6.7:1 on qvl-grey-light). An addition to the CI sheet, flagged for approval.

tokens.name: qvl-petrol-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of petrol buttons (petrol mixed 86 % with black).

tokens.name: qvl-petrol-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of petrol buttons (petrol mixed 74 % with black).

tokens.name: qvl-orange-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of orange buttons (orange mixed 88 % with black).

tokens.name: qvl-orange-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of orange buttons and link hover on light grounds (orange mixed 78 % with black).

tokens.name: qvl-night
